_metadata.description: Bridge interactive transport obligations for Device Control desktop sessions; planned evidence is not completion.

requirements.title: Terminal parity
requirements.description: Given an existing PTY session is running, when interactive desktop transport is enabled, vrooli-bridge shall ensure terminal byte and resize semantics remain correct.

validation.notes: Desktop transport is additive to the existing channel path; focused interactive/companion race tests pass. Terminal live regression and final producer receipt remain to be attached.

requirements.title: Protocol confusion
requirements.description: Given a frame is sent to an interactive desktop session, when admission evaluates it, vrooli-bridge shall ensure that it rejects the wrong protocol or lane.

validation.notes: Typed protocol, lane, size, stale-epoch, role, and admission rejection tests pass in Bridge interactive packages.

requirements.title: Node revocation
requirements.description: Given media and input channels are active, when the node is revoked, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Existing channels lose authority.

validation.notes: Revocation and stale authority are covered by focused admission/channel tests; live paired control-plane receipt remains open.

requirements.title: Loss before effect
requirements.description: Given the route disconnects before command admission, when the client reconnects, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: The owner can safely resume the unperformed step.

validation.notes: Generation-correlated signaling and reconnect seams are implemented; deterministic browser/companion reconnect evidence remains open.

requirements.title: Loss after effect
requirements.description: Given the route disconnects after submission, when an alternate provider is available, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: The original receipt is reconciled before fallback.

validation.notes: Receipt-correlated typed response handling is implemented; alternate-provider fallback evidence remains open.

requirements.title: Setup-owned native screen-sharing bootstrap
requirements.description: Given a Bridge-managed macOS node has no usable native Device Control companion session, when commissioning has enabled the built-in macOS Screen Sharing provider, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: an authenticated, lease-bound Vrooli bootstrap transport can relay only the supported screen/input protocol needed to establish native readiness; it shall not require direct node access, an operator-side remote-control application, software installed on the Mac, SSH, or an arbitrary socket tunnel, and it shall close when Device Control reaches desktop_ready.

validation.notes: Requires setup receipt proving the native provider was enabled, a typed relay/client contract test, and live minimouse evidence that the fallback can reach native companion readiness without direct node access.

requirements.title: Slow viewer
requirements.description: Given a viewer cannot consume frames, when the stream continues, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Queues remain bounded and stop remains responsive.

validation.notes: Bounded signaling and transport queue seams are covered by focused tests; live slow-viewer qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Relay only
requirements.description: Given direct peer connectivity is unavailable, when a supported relay route is selected, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Authorized viewing works with recorded cost and latency.

validation.notes: TURN route metadata is bounded, forwarded through the node-local Device Control signal adapter, and consumed by the browser signaling path in focused tests; an actual relay-session receipt and cost/latency measurement remain open.

requirements.title: Attached revoke
requirements.description: Given a device grant is revoked while the host stays online, when device input arrives, vrooli-bridge shall ensure: Device control stops without revoking unrelated host sessions.

validation.notes: Device-scoped companion and interactive revocation paths are implemented and tested; live unrelated-session isolation evidence remains open.
